caption:
The Milky Way is not an arch. The lens bent it.

A wide-angle lens makes the arch. The Galaxy is not curved.
The photo is from Brazil, with white dunes and dark lagoons.
This NASA picture is an artist’s drawing of the Milky Way inside a halo of million-degree gas.

What the astronomers say: the photographer framed the Galaxy to match the dark lagoon, so it looks like a cosmic eye.

NASA picture: GSFC, GSFC_20171208_Archive_e000261. NASA/CXC/M.Weiss/Ohio State/A Gupta et al.
